description: A six km trail leading to a small A-frame cabin on the West end of Home Lake. Cabin is available for public use on a first come basis for a maximum stay of 2 nights. Users must sign the book at the trailhead Portions of the trail are quite wet and muddy.
directions: The Home Lake Trailhead is located at kilometre 43.5 on the Kluskus Forest Service Road. The trail is 6 km one way.
title: Home Lake Trails
